note: A saved flight now says when it was flown and whether it still describes your rocket. The launch report carried no timestamp at all - so the one panel people screenshot and forward gave no way to tell a three-day-old report from one flown a minute ago - and opening a saved flight from the table rendered it with the full prominence of a fresh one with nothing to say the design had moved on since. The report header now says 'Flown ...', with the date once the flight is not from today, and states either that it matches the design as it stands or exactly what has changed: the design, the motor, the launch conditions. A banner says the same above the results, in the same place and style as the existing note about a different aerodynamics model. This matters most for a change that does not affect the climb - edit a parachute and an older flight's apogee, top speed and pad weight all still match, so every visible column agrees while the landing numbers came from a different chute. Where the app cannot tell, it says nothing rather than accusing an old flight of a difference it cannot see.
